text: Severe multi-vehicle highway accident near Dallas TX. 3 passengers injured, immediate ambulance, heavy cutters, and emergency medical team needed.
Landslide blocked mountain pass in Kathmandu Nepal. 8 vehicles buried under mud and boulders, urgent excavator and rescue team needed!
Tsunami wave surge damaged harbor in Honshu Japan. 5 fishermen missing at sea, coastal patrol boats deployed.
Multi-story parking structure collapsed in Chicago IL. 4 cars crushed underneath, 2 drivers screaming for help!
Traffic collision on Interstate 95 near Miami FL. 2 cars overturned, ambulance dispatched for injured driver.
Hillside mudslide destroyed 3 homes in Rio de Janeiro. 6 people trapped in mud, need urgent rescue team and clean water.
Coastal wave surge flooded beachfront resort in Bali Indonesia. Guests evacuated to higher ground safely.
Bus crash on mountain highway near Denver CO. 15 passengers injured, multiple ambulances and blood plasma required!
Bridge collapse during heavy storm in Pittsburgh PA. Vehicle plummeted into river, rescue divers needed immediately!
Rockslide blocked highway tunnel in Switzerland. No vehicles trapped, maintenance crews clearing debris.
High speed car crash on freeway in San Francisco CA. Fuel leaking from tank, fire engine and paramedics requested.
Tsunami warning sirens activated in Hawaii after offshore 7.8 magnitude quake. Coastal areas evacuated.
Old warehouse roof caved in due to heavy snow accumulation in Buffalo NY. 2 workers stuck inside, need emergency team.
Minor fender bender on Main Street causing slight traffic delay. No injuries reported.
Mountain landslide swept away footbridge in Peru. 5 hikers stranded across ravine, need helicopter evacuation and food.
Scaffold collapse at construction site in New York NY. 3 workers injured, trauma team and paramedics on site.
Tsunami sea surge submerged coastal roads in Philippines. 10 families evacuated to school shelter needing clean drinking water.
Motorcycle accident on rural highway in Texas. Rider unconscious, urgent air ambulance required!
Soil erosion caused small embankment slump along railway line. Train traffic slowed down safely.
CRITICAL! Industrial boiler explosion caused building collapse in Mumbai India. 12 workers trapped under burning rubble, need fire rescue & burn care!
